title: Page 130
transc:
SH Beckwith  Washn July 15th 1864
Reliance Kimball Belly tulip Lady thinks Meridens princeton very
badly cut up by the Eddy ripley and that
it does not now exced Gilbert zebra richland summer
of all orbits tulip It is now at Churn
or between there and Leesburg stop watkins with Elliott
sprague summer should be between whites sampson & Leesburg
stick Ricketts and what has arrived talbot morgan pelham
are between Watkins & Happy yacht repeats for Shark
Watkins & the Morgan pelham to comply with your
letter trifle issued panther Behead receives an answer to
his whiff to you of wherry yard It will
take Austin or Andrew libels for Watkins to get
back stop Cupid does not understand your letter sent
by me as an repeat for Watkins recall &
awaits positive repeats stop He thinks on Watkins return
the robin may come back Watkins repeats now are
to romance racine till recalled wiley Sandusky mem t'g
